notes.title: Hymer 2000 Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

Developed by doBell Studio, the team behind SELF, and published by indienova, the interactive text adventure game Hymer 2000 has launched its demo today!

Hymer 2000 is an interactive text-based puzzle game. You can converse freely with a computer named Hymer, without being confined to a fixed set of text options. The game features an open-ended search function that allows you to enter any keyword to locate conversational logs between Hymer and others. Throughout this process, you will uncover new keywords, gather clues, collect "faces," and ultimately unveil the secret Hymer has been guarding before shutting it down once and for all.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3255860/2000/"][/dynamiclink]

The demo includes roughly the first 20–30 minutes of gameplay, with some limitations placed on the "search" feature. The full version is scheduled to release by the end of the year—stay tuned!

Discord：[url="https://discord.gg/nbHP7hMefC"]https://discord.gg/nbHP7hMefC[/url][/p]

notes.title: SELF - April Update
notes.content:
Hello there,

I hope everything goes well.

It's been a while since our last update, we've got a very special update for you this week! In addition to some polishes and bug fixes, we've also added a mode for improving the color accessibility. I hope this can help more players can enjoy SELF easily as we do have many simple colored graphics in our game.

[h2]Full patch notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] A new color mode for improving the color accessibility
[*] Added window mode has multiple resolutions support
[*] Improved reading experience by adjusting the effects on the texts in the game carefully
[*] Added Traditional Chinese support
[*] Edited text and spelling correction
[*] Other minor fixes and polishes
[/list]

Compare figure before and after enabling the assist color mode:

[h3]AFTER[/h3]

Another good news is that SELF trading cards with which you can unlock new emoticons and profile backgrounds are now available!

:selfs::selfok::selfhappy::selfsad::selffive::selffour::selfthree::selfone:

We are preparing a patch for the Nintendo Switch version too, please be patient as it will take a bit longer as there are more restricted QA process for the console version.

notes.title: SELF is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35036783/ac0dc78064309466c1a6c426cda4edf1e705274e.png[/img]

Hello everyone! We are so happy to announce that SELF is out now! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1074170/SELF/

SELF is a suspenseful Kafkaesque text-based adventure game made by a two-men game studio doBell. We want to thank all the fans and friends in the community for your incredible support. This project started in 2016, so I hope we didn't make you wait too long :D

You need to help the protagonist to look for his disappear dad. During the journey, you need to make some choices, and each routine will lead you to different endings.

It may take you 2-3 hours to complete the whole game. You will find out what really happened only if you collect all endings.

If you have any questions or comments, welcome to join our Discord and share the story in your eyes with us: [url=https://discord.gg/g8UBx3z][/url]

Hope you can enjoy it!

notes.title: SELF will be available on Jan, 16th.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35036783/004734180325abe1567adf87a7dfaf89412d338f.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! We are happy to tell you that SELF will release on January, 16th. That means only 7 days left till it launches! 

The price of SELF is $4.99. And if you want to buy origin soundtrack, it costs another $1.99. Please remember that it will come with a 10% off discount for the first-week release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35036783/be830c0fd90ba1823e322ba0a62422a86f2718ed.png[/img]

SELF is a suspenseful Kafkaesque text-based adventure game with simulation and puzzle mechanics. If you want to know more about this game, you can check the Steam page or official game page:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1074170/SELF/]Steam Page[/url]
